en: Uuurrrrrgh....
Oh, Alice. You've awoken.
Father? What happened?
I'll explain later.  Right now we're going to perform a ceremony.
Eh?!
Your body has been pushed to its limits.  Now you're on Death's doorstep, reaching out to knock.
I see.  So I really was nothing more than a mere doll.
Don't be ridiculous! You're nothing of the sort!
To me you are a treasured daughter and I, I, do not want to lose you!
Exactly! I feel that same way too.
So please, do not say such sad things.
Father... Mikhail....
I would like for you to live life as a human.  For you to find happiness as a human!
As a person?  Father.  What are you talking about?
The purpose of Astulla, the ceremony we're about to perform, is to turn you into a human being, milady.
F-father....
Alice.  You are simply my daughter.  And that is why we're holding this ceremony.  All right?
Y-yes!
Good.  Mikhail!  Let's begin the rite!
As you wish.  Leave it to me.
Hear our prayer.
We command you.
Mother of all life, oh endless land.
How beautiful your flows, wavering water.
Time passing and time lost, we now call for your return!
Now show yourself here.  In that righteous form, utopia!
Urk, uuugggh?!
Hrm? What's wrong, Mikhail?
Uuggh, gugugugu.
Hey, are you okay?  Are you in pain?  Hey?
Earth to Mikhail, get ahold of yourself man!
Huhhuhhu.....
Mikhail?  What happened to you?!
Kyaa!
Huhhuhhu.
Eh?! Wha? Wha? Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!!
Mikhail became Lucille?!
At last, at last I've done it!
Huhuhu, huhuhuhuhu. Keeeeekkekekekeke!
What the heck is this?  What just happened?
Thought so.  Thought that was the case.
Huh?
Alice. The two of them live within a single body, as two sides of the same coin.
Although Mikhail himself is likely unaware of that fact.
Oh my.  Professor, you realized it?
I suspected but wasn't certain of it.
F-father!  Explain it to me!  Whatever do you mean?
Mikhail was originally an acolyte in the service of the dark lord Varuudanu.  However, he loved humanity.  And so he backstabbed the dark lord and saved us all!
Huhun. But that complete idiot failed to realize something.
That he had been posessed by "me", living deep inside.
Then that would mean..  No way?!
Huhhuhhuhhu.  Right.  As of now I've fully subverted this vessel and it is mine.
You gotta be kidding!?
And with that, my mission is nearly complete.
A mission, you say?  To do what?
We are resurrecting Lord Varuudanu, our god.  Obviously.
What did you say?!
Now that Mikhail is no longer in the way...  Huhhuhhuhhu.
S-stop! Stop at once! Why unleash a disaster?!
If Varuudanu is reborn, the world will be demolished. Mankind will go extinct!
N-not that!  Don't do it, Lucille!
Keekkekekekeke!  Oh I had nooo idea such a thing would happen.
Now, Lord Varuudanu, our god! It is the hour of your rebirth!
Obliterate this world with your absolute power! Wipe out all of the people! Keeeeekkekekekeke!
In fact, how about you start with the pesky brat there and give her an especially brutal demise!
!? O_O
Kyaaa!
Watch out!  Varuudanu is arising!
Huhu, huhuhu.  Ahhhaha, aahahahahaha.  Keeekkekekeke.
Ugghhh....
Alice!
Alice!
Open your eyes, Alice!
Mmrmmmnng......
Oh, Alice!  You're awake!
Well done, Alice.
Varuudanu's resurrection has been halted, and we have you to thank for it.
What is it, Alice?
Where's Mikhail?
Slam
W-who's there?
Lucille?!  You survived?!
Lucille, Varuudanu is no more.
What you hoped for shall not come to pass!
Hold on, Father.  Something's off here, wouldn't you say?
Kyaa!?
Mikhail!  Is it really you, Mikhail?!
Huh?  Where on Earth have I been all this time?
Ehhh?  You don't remember a thing?
Varuudanu's defeat has broken the hold that a dark power had on you.
Then did Lucille die?
I told you, right?  Mikhail and Lucille are two sides of the same coin.  She likely still lives on, deep within him.  Not that she'll be able to assert herself again, though.
Hmmmm.  I wonder if it's okay to leave things that way?
Who can say.
Excuse me.  What are you two talking about?
S-e-cret!
Indeed, it's private.
O-oh, you two....
Huhuhu.
Well then.  How about we get started?
Oh?  Started on what?
It's obvious.  Astulla.
Ah!
Alice has been pushing the limits of her endurance, putting up a brave front so that she wouldn't cause us to worry.  The strain has caught up to her, and her body really has run out of time.
Father, so you noticed that, huh.
Of course I did.  Alice, you're my daughter.  You needn't hold back your troubles.
Good.  Then, let's begin.
